column1: # phoneme_suffix: a particle or ending after a listed word (물고기를 물꼬기를).
# Phase 2 (2026-10-10). phoneme_ending: an ending a ㄴ ㅁ verb stem tenses (신고 신꼬, 제24항);
# phoneme_l_ending: an ending after the adnominal ㄹ (할게 할께); phoneme_bound: a bound noun
# after the adnominal ㄹ across a space (할 수 할 쑤, 제27항).
# phoneme_aux: an auxiliary after a verb form (남지 않았다): 1 matches the first syllable,
# 2 only the whole word (남지 마, not 마감);
# phoneme_numeral: Sino numeral syllables (no ㄴ insertion after 1일: 일 이레).
